1.name: A Certain Lady

effects.text: Mark 1 {mark} for each enemy which is in play with this card. After finishing Ridding the Woods, {oneTime}.

1.text: {triggeredForced} Mark 1 {mark} for each enemy which is in play with this card. After finishing Ridding the Woods, {oneTime}.
1.helpText:
This lady has a tendency to get into bad company. Each time an enemy is near, you must mark a box, and if the track is complete, she becomes one of them!
However, if you keep her out of this influence for the entire expansion, she is safe and has chosen your side instead.

4.name: Rogue Lady

effects.text: When played, cross out 1 {coin} production on 1 card in play. If you do, mark 1 {mark} from left to right.

4.text: {triggeredForced} When played, cross out 1 {coin} production on 1 card in play. If you do, mark 1 {mark} from left to right.
4.helpText: The lady has turned against you! Each time she is played, she requires you to cross out 1 [money] production on 1 card. If you do, mark 1 of the boxes, meaning she will continue until she has sabotaged 6 [money] production!

description: This is a card from the Ridding the Woods expansion.
to_verify: A Certain Lady : l'icône finale (parchemin barré) est l'icône d'usage unique : l'effet est rayé une fois l'extension terminée.
